subscriptions.summary: Configured providers start collapsed. Expand one to see its existing account, usage, and settings controls.
subscriptions.details: The default view has fictitious Codex and Kimi Code connections. Quota display preferences have a tinted section above the bordered list of configured providers. The provider-list branches show empty, loading, and failed status checks.

add-provider.summary: One compact provider selector and one form below it.
add-provider.details: Selecting an option opens its inline fields in the prototype. The kit uses an anchored list and matching screen snapshots to simulate the implementation’s in-place select. Codex and Kimi Code are already configured in this fixture.

setup-cursor.summary: Enter a masked key. The simulated Save action shows the saved-but-unusable result.
setup-cursor.details: No key is saved. Do not enter a real key.

setup-ollama.summary: Ollama Cloud takes a key; a local server uses an address.
setup-ollama.details: Save simulates saving the address and returns to the same roster with Ollama added. The Cloud key form is a static example. The current Cloud route does not support unauthenticated local chat.

subscriptions-with-ollama.summary: The collapsed Ollama row joins the existing Codex and Kimi Code rows.
subscriptions-with-ollama.details: Quota display preferences stay outside the roster. The new row confirms an address was saved, not that the server is reachable.

claude-browser.summary: Fictitious browser authorization. Expand the fallback to enter a callback URL or code.

copilot-device.summary: Fictitious GitHub device authorization, with a sample code.

setup-opencode-go.summary: OpenCode Go uses its existing key in Settings → Models. Check again demonstrates a key-not-found result.

add-first-provider.summary: All providers are initially unconfigured in this first-use fixture.
add-first-provider.details: The first-use fixture simulates Ollama, Claude, Cursor, Codex and Kimi Code. Other options appear for review; use the default roster to try their setup paths.

add-after-first-provider.summary: Read-only picker showing the configured providers after the simulated Ollama save.

add-another-provider.summary: Read-only picker showing the configured providers after the simulated Ollama save.
